newsitem.title: USA: CME Jan lumber falls limit on liquidation, stops.
newsitem.headline: CME Jan lumber falls limit on liquidation, stops.

text.p: Long liquidation in November spilled over into January CME lumber futures and that month quickly fell the $10.00 per tbf limit in early trade.
January was limit down at $402.60 per tbf with limitless November down $9.50 at $472.80 per tbf at 0908 CST. Other months were down $9.70 to $4.80 per tbf.
Liquidation developed after the recent sharp rise in both futures and cash prices to new highs, traders said.
